issues.description: Typo 'stlib' in the deprecation docstring directive.
issues.detail: In falcon/testing/helpers.py the .. deprecated:: 4.3 block says 'Use the stlib's :func:`contextlib.redirect_stdout`...'. 'stlib' should be 'stdlib' (or 'standard library'). This is user-facing rendered documentation; worth fixing in the same PR.

issues.description: News fragment uses `.misc.rst` but this is a user-visible deprecation.
issues.detail: docs/_newsfragments/2569.misc.rst is classified as 'misc'. Falcon's towncrier conventions typically use a `deprecation` (or similar) fragment type for user-facing deprecations so it lands in the right changelog section. Confirm the fragment type matches the project's towncrier configuration.

issues.description: Deprecation test may emit an unrelated ResourceWarning from unclosed StringIO.
issues.detail: test_deprecated_redirected creates io.StringIO() inside the pytest.warns block but never closes it. Under strict warning filters this can pollute the captured warnings list and, in principle, mask or interleave with the DeprecatedWarning assertion. Using `with io.StringIO() as output:` is cleaner.

issues.description: Deprecation message refers to functions without the `contextlib.` qualifier in one place.
issues.detail: The decorator message says 'contextlib.redirect_stdout and contextlib.redirect_stderr' (good), but the rendered Sphinx note in the docstring only says 'stlib's :func:`contextlib.redirect_stdout`...'. Consistent phrasing and a brief one-line code example would make the migration path obvious to users hitting the warning.

review.summary: The PR cleanly deprecates `falcon.testing.redirected` with a decorator-based warning, a Sphinx `.. deprecated::` directive, a news fragment, and a corresponding test, and migrates the internal test file to `contextlib`. No correctness or regression risk found: the deprecation decorator wraps the contextmanager in the standard Falcon idiom, and the new test asserts both the warning and that behavior is preserved. Findings are limited to a doc typo ('stlib'), the news fragment category, and minor test hygiene. Safe to merge after the typo fix.
